_comment: A plan in the map lab's EXPORTED shape (planning/map-lab/src/core/persist.ts,
FORMAT_VERSION 4), hand-authored for P6.1 because the owner called P6.0's
exit and asked to start from empty (2026-08-16).
It exists to pin the two places where the lab's document and the product's
domain deliberately DISAGREE, so P6.3 ports the editor instead of
1. col and level are 0-BASED here and 1-based in ShelfAddress. The domain
REFUSES a 0 rather than re-basing it silently, so the importer adds one
and an off-by-one raises instead of filing a book one shelf over.
2. section ids are '<caseId>:sN' by array position, and persist.ts REBUILDS
them on every import on the stated grounds that nothing outside the
document refers to one. That stopped being true: shelves.section_id
refers to one, from another table, behind a RESTRICT foreign key.
Two storeys, because one storey cannot show that rooms are found only on
their own (MAP_PLAN 3.7); a bookcase with two sections, because a plain one
would not exercise the address that prints a section; a ragged column,
because equal columns make several rules unobservable.
